title: Preserve encoding_errors when adapting CSV text buffers to bytes
answers: Why does read_csv raise UnicodeEncodeError on StringIO despite encoding_errors="replace"?
Why is encoding_errors="ignore" ignored for a CSV text buffer?
How should C and pyarrow CSV engines handle encoding errors when converting text to bytes?
body:
Symptom: read_csv on a text buffer containing an unencodable character raises UnicodeEncodeError despite encoding_errors="replace" or "ignore" with the C or pyarrow engine.
Root cause: pandas/io/common.py:_BytesIOWrapper.read encoded text without forwarding the configured error handler, implicitly using strict handling.
Fix pattern: Forward errors from pandas/io/common.py:get_handle into pandas/io/common.py:_BytesIOWrapper.__init__, store it, and apply it in _BytesIOWrapper.read when encoding text to bytes.
Constraints: This applies to text buffers adapted to bytes for the C and pyarrow engines; the Python engine reads text buffers without encoding them. Preserve the wrapper's default errors="strict". pandas/tests/io/parser/test_encoding.py:test_text_buffer_encoding_errors verifies replacement and omission of a lone surrogate as "x?" and "x".
applies: CSV text-buffer handling through _BytesIOWrapper for the C and pyarrow engines.
